body.x: i-ESG Inc. (CEO Kim Jongwoong) participated in CES 2025, held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10 (local time), as part of the KOTRA Pavilion.

i-ESG is a prominent player in the ESG solutions sector for corporate clients, specializing in Software as a Service (SaaS). After securing major government-supported projects, the company has established a client base that includes leading large and mid-sized companies in Korea. It also accelerates global expansion by establishing a local entity in the UAE.

The company is recognized for its advanced capabilities in integration, SaaS, AI, and big data technologies. Through these, i-ESG provides a single-platform solution to address various ESG-related needs, including data integration and management, automated reporting, and supply chain management.

At CES 2025, i-ESG showcased its key solutions, including the ESG Self-assessment Module, which helps businesses evaluate ESG risks and develop improvement strategies, and the Greenhouse Gas Management Solution, which systematically manages emission data and promotes the achievement of reduction targets. Both received significant attention from potential clients.

Additionally, the company demonstrated the ESG Automated Reporting solution, which streamlines reporting processes, and the Supply Chain Management Solution, which assesses ESG risks in global supply chains and supports sustainable supply chain management. These innovations were highly praised for their efficiency and functionality.

body.cap: i-ESG's booth at CES 2025 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The ESG Data Management Solution, which integrates ESG data to provide real-time analysis and support strategic decision-making, also garnered positive feedback from visitors.

An i-ESG representative stated, “We decided to participate in CES 2025 to connect with global clients considering ESG solutions and explore strategic partnerships and collaborations. Our technology and expertise present attractive alternatives for mid-sized and small businesses struggling with international regulatory compliance, as well as for investors and venture capitalists keen on ESG technologies.”

They added, “By 2025, we plan to complete the development of an integrated ESG Data Management solution and globalize all our existing solutions. This will position us as a world-class company in the ESG SaaS sector. Additionally, we will establish new business models through an ESG marketplace, continuing to diversify our strategic offerings.”

body.cap: Alex Sigrist, AVING News reporter, interviewing with i-ESG representatives | Photo by AVING News

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
